text:
Maya: Quick UX check on rule ordering. Bulk edits can leave duplicate priorities and the list just stacks them. Proposal: show a tiny inline "Conflict" pill with count and a Resolve action that opens a small, keyboard-first modal. Owen: Pill is good. Needs to be tab-focusable and open on Enter. Esc should close modal and return focus to the pill. Josie: Accessibility: pill should have role=button and aria-describedby pointing to a concise summary. Also announce conflicts via an aria-live region when they occur. Example: `Priority conflict detected between "Billing - Auto" and "Billing - Manual".` Nina: From preview simulation side, resolving should only re-run the sim for the affected route. We can accept a route delta from the API and patch the sim state incrementally. Maya: Modal content idea: side-by-side conditions, small inline preview of match ordering, primary actions Promote/Demote, secondary Merge behind a "More" menu. Merge needs confirmation and explicit copy on what it does. Owen: Also add an import-flow toast: "Priority conflicts detected in Route: Checkout 1 Click to review." Clicking focuses the top conflict pill. Toast must appear in the toast tray for keyboard users. Josie: Snippet for aria-live: ```
Priority conflict detected between "A" and "B"
``` Ensure pluralization handling for screen readers. design-bot: Uploaded mock: https://redwood.design/mockups/1720012345-conflict-pill.png Maya: Action items: Josie to add ARIA copy & tests, Nina to spec incremental sim API, Owen & I to prototype the pill/modal and bring to UX sync.
